# HELP guardian_up 1 if fresh robot data is available
# TYPE guardian_up gauge
guardian_up{robot="go2-01"} 1
# HELP guardian_telemetry_age_seconds Age of the latest robot data
# TYPE guardian_telemetry_age_seconds gauge
guardian_telemetry_age_seconds{robot="go2-01"} 1.0
# HELP guardian_state 1 for the current state
# TYPE guardian_state gauge
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="INIT"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="SELF_TEST"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="READY"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="MISSION"} 1
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="RTB"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="CHARGING"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="SAFE_MODE"} 0
guardian_state{robot="go2-01",state="EMERGENCY_STOP"} 0
# HELP guardian_battery_percent Battery charge
# TYPE guardian_battery_percent gauge
guardian_battery_percent{robot="go2-01"} 55.5
# HELP guardian_cpu_percent CPU usage
# TYPE guardian_cpu_percent gauge
guardian_cpu_percent{robot="go2-01"} 12.0
# HELP guardian_ram_percent RAM usage
# TYPE guardian_ram_percent gauge
guardian_ram_percent{robot="go2-01"} 30.0
# HELP guardian_disk_percent Disk usage
# TYPE guardian_disk_percent gauge
guardian_disk_percent{robot="go2-01"} 40.0
# HELP guardian_watchdog_ok 1 if the watchdog is healthy
# TYPE guardian_watchdog_ok gauge
guardian_watchdog_ok{robot="go2-01"} 1
